title: NAPCC National Mission On Sustainable Habitat
definition: One of the eight core missions under the National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC), aimed at making habitats sustainable through improvements in energy efficiency in buildings, management of solid waste, and a shift to public transport.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for GS Paper III (Environment/Urbanization) and GS Paper I (Geography/Urbanization). Frequently linked with Smart Cities Mission, AMRUT, and Swachh Bharat Mission.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of NAPCC National Mission On Sustainable Habitat.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
